title: Read xlsx Files with a Native Parser
text: read_xlsx() returns plain data.frame, taking first row header: Column types guessed cells read area; dates come back POSIXct UTC. xlsx_sheets() lists sheets, sheet takes name index: read_xlsx_all() reads every sheet single workbook parse returns named list data.frames: Reads can windowed A1 range (column-row-forms work ), skip / n_max: col_names accepts TRUE, FALSE (auto names, header row becomes data), character vector sized read area. col_types takes "text", "numeric", "date", "logical", "guess", "skip", "list", recycled length 1: arguments: na blanks matching cells, trim_ws trims surrounding whitespace, name_repair one "unique" (default), "minimal", "check_unique". See ?read_xlsx details. Set RCXL_THREADS environment variable override worker count. Sheets 4MB read serially regardless.
code: library(rcxl)  path <- system.file("extdata", "flights.xlsx", package = "rcxl") df <- read_xlsx(path) dim(df) #> [1] 100  10 multi <- system.file("extdata", "multisheet.xlsx", package = "rcxl") xlsx_sheets(multi) #> [1] "Alpha" "Beta"  "Gamma"  read_xlsx(multi, sheet = "Beta") read_xlsx(multi, sheet = 2) sheets <- read_xlsx_all(multi) names(sheets) #> [1] "Alpha" "Beta"  "Gamma" read_xlsx(path, range = "B3:D10") read_xlsx(path, range = "B:C") read_xlsx(path, skip = 5, n_max = 10) read_xlsx(path, col_names = FALSE) read_xlsx(path, col_types = "text")                    # everything as character read_xlsx(path, col_types = c("skip", rep("guess", 9)))  # drop the first column

title: Read an xlsx worksheet — read_xlsx
code: read_xlsx(   path,   sheet = 1L,   col_names = TRUE,   trim_ws = TRUE,   range = NULL,   skip = 0L,   n_max = Inf,   col_types = NULL,   na = "",   name_repair = c("unique", "minimal", "check_unique") )

title: Read an xlsx worksheet — read_xlsx
text: path Path xlsx file. Tilde expansion applied. sheet Worksheet read, 1-based index sheet name. Overridden range names sheet. col_names TRUE use first row read area column names, FALSE number V1, V2, ..., character vector names, one per sheet column including skipped via col_types (skipped names dropped result). trim_ws Trim leading trailing whitespace string cells column names? range A1-style cell range read: "B3:D87", single cell "B3", whole columns "B:D", whole rows "3:87", optionally sheet-qualified "Sheet1!B3:D87" "'Sheet'!B3:D87". given, skip n_max ignored. axis range bounds read exactly, blank cells included; open axis trimmed sheet extent. skip Number rows skip reading anything. Ignored range given. n_max Maximum number data rows read. column name row count. Ignored range given. col_types NULL guess every column, character vector "guess", "skip", "logical", "numeric", "date", "text" "list". single value applies every column; otherwise supply one entry per sheet column, counting "skip" columns. "list" column keeps cell's type: length-one numeric, POSIXct, logical character elements, blank cells logical NA. na Character vector strings read NA. Matched whitespace-trimmed cell text; entries parse numbers also blank numeric date cells holding value. name_repair resolve column names result. "unique" suffixes repeated names via make.unique() separator "_", "minimal" keeps names read, "check_unique" errors repeat.

title: Read an xlsx worksheet — read_xlsx
text: data.frame one column per worksheet column read.

title: Read an xlsx worksheet — read_xlsx
text: guessed column becomes character holds string cell, logical holds booleans, POSIXct holds date cells plain numbers, numeric otherwise. Every cell read area informs guess. Columns blank cells become logical NA. Date cells returned POSIXct UTC; 1900 1904 date systems handled, including nonexistent 29 Feb 1900 1900 system counts. Cells coerced type forced col_types become NA, warning giving count first offending cell.

title: Read an xlsx worksheet — read_xlsx
code: types <- system.file("extdata", "types.xlsx", package = "rcxl") str(read_xlsx(types)) #> 'data.frame':	4 obs. of  6 variables: #>  $ id    : chr  "007" "00042" "12345" NA #>  $ amount: num  1.5 -2.0 0.0 1.0e+06 #>  $ flag  : logi  TRUE FALSE NA TRUE #>  $ stamp : POSIXct, format: "2021-01-01 00:00:00" "2022-01-01 12:00:00" ... #>  $ mix   : chr  "10" "twenty" "TRUE" "61" #>  $ words : chr  "TRUE" "false" "3.5" "abc"  # read a rectangle rather than the whole sheet read_xlsx(types, range = "A1:C3") #>      id amount  flag #> 1   007    1.5  TRUE #> 2 00042   -2.0 FALSE  # force every column to character instead of guessing str(read_xlsx(types, col_types = "text")) #> 'data.frame':	4 obs. of  6 variables: #>  $ id    : chr  "007" "00042" "12345" NA #>  $ amount: chr  "1.5" "-2" "0" "1000000" #>  $ flag  : chr  "TRUE" "FALSE" NA "TRUE" #>  $ stamp : chr  "44197" "44562.5" "30" NA #>  $ mix   : chr  "10" "twenty" "TRUE" "61" #>  $ words : chr  "TRUE" "false" "3.5" "abc"  # a sheet other than the first, by name or by position multi <- system.file("extdata", "multisheet.xlsx", package = "rcxl") read_xlsx(multi, sheet = "Beta") #>   x #> 1 2

NULL reads every sheet workbook order. col_names TRUE use first row read area column names, FALSE number V1, V2, ..., character vector names, one per sheet column including skipped via col_types (skipped names dropped result). trim_ws Trim leading trailing whitespace string cells column names? range read_xlsx(), except sheet-qualified range error ; select sheets sheets. skip Number rows skip reading anything. Ignored range given. n_max Maximum number data rows read. column name row count. Ignored range given. col_types NULL guess every column, character vector "guess", "skip", "logical", "numeric", "date", "text" "list". single value applies every column; otherwise supply one entry per sheet column, counting "skip" columns. "list" column keeps cell's type: length-one numeric, POSIXct, logical character elements, blank cells logical NA. na Character vector strings read NA. Matched whitespace-trimmed cell text; entries parse numbers also blank numeric date cells holding value. name_repair read_xlsx(). "check_unique" error names offending sheet.
